title: Managing the two mode outputs of triboelectric nanogenerators to reach a pulsed peak power density of 31 MW m−2
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05225K, Paper
Junpeng Wu, Xiaoyi Li, Na Xue, Jie Wang, Guoqiang Xu, Shougang Chen, Hongzhi Cui, Yunlong Zi, Zhong Lin Wang
The TENG-MC system features dual-mode output with UO mode and LL mode. The LL mode can provide cathodic protection for 8 h after operating for 2.5 min. The UO mode constructs a pest prevention system that can penetrate insect egg walls.
